proposition: Jamāl al-Dīn Muḥammad may have been a key player in the Timurid-Turkmen power struggle in Fars in 872/1467-68 (a Jamāl al-Dīn Turka appears among the pro-Turkmen notables of Isfahan in the Kitāb-i Diyarbakriyya); nothing more is heard of him.

mediation.who: Kitāb-i Diyarbakriyya, as quoted by Binbaş

mediation.note: MK says 'may have been'; the identification of this Jamāl al-Dīn with Ibn Turka's son is an inference
